c1.title: Rounded rectangle
c1.text: Target: **3 dimensions**. Centered on the origin.

c2.title: Square with 4 holes
c2.text: Target: **3 dimensions**. Hint: a construction square through the hole centers, and Equal.

c3.title: Hex nut
c3.text: Target: **2 dimensions**. Which polygon option gives "across flats" directly?

c5.title: Trapezoid with a hole
c5.text: Target: **4 dimensions**. The hole is in the middle of the height, on the axis (Midpoint, Symmetric).

c6.title: Slotted bar with 3 holes
c6.text: Target: **3 dimensions**. End holes are concentric with the slot ends; the middle one sits at the midpoint.

m1.title: Mirror: bracket
m1.text: Draw the **right half** only, then sketch **Mirror** about a vertical construction line through the origin.

p1.title: Circular pattern: flange with notches
p1.text: Two sketch circular patterns: 6 holes, and 6 notches on the rim shifted by 30°.

o1.title: Offset: frame
o1.text: Draw the outer outline, then **Offset** it 5 inward. Extrude the region between the two outlines.

a.title: Intake arm plate
a.text: Uses: tangent, Mirror, polygon (circumscribed), circular pattern, Offset, Trim, sketch fillet. One sketch, Extrude 5.

b.title: Adjustable motor mount
b.text: Uses: center rectangle, sketch chamfer, concentric, arc + Offset for slots, circular pattern, Symmetric. One sketch, Extrude 4.
